# ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry Daily Update (May 20, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's activity focused on infrastructure updates, specifically migrating CircleCI configurations, and addressing several flaky tests and an op-reth bootstrap incompatibility.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### CI Configuration Update
- The `circleci_ip_ranges` flag was removed from six jobs in `.circleci/config.yml`, and five Tier-B jobs were migrated to the `circleci-repo-rpc-secrets` CircleCI context. ([#1233](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1233))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES
No issues were closed today.

## NEW ISSUES
### Flaky Test Identification
- A flaky failure in `FuzzEncodeDecodeBlob` from `op-service/eth` was identified, with a root cause and fix proposed in a draft PR. The issue was related to large error string allocations. ([#20935](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20935))
- Another flaky failure in `FuzzDetectNonBijectivity` from `op-service/eth` was reported, with a draft PR proposing a fix for non-deterministic fuzzing due to an incorrectly captured `*rand.Rand`. ([#20936](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20936))

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### L2CM DevFeatures Removal for Auditor Review [#20084](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20084)
Discussion continues regarding the removal of the DevFeatures flag system to make L2CM the default codepath. A comment from yoonchung8822 suggests inserting a standard comment in the code to track future actions related to the flag.

### Flaky Test: `TestFollowL2_ReorgRecovery` [#19967](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/19967)
The flaky `TestFollowL2_ReorgRecovery` test has resurfaced. The latest failure, observed on May 19, 2026, shows a different error signature (sequencer RPC deadline exceeded) compared to the original report, but it is believed to stem from the same underlying timing/sync issue.

### op-reth: Minimal Bedrock Bootstrap Incompatibility [#20821](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20821)
An issue where `op-reth` panics on launch when using the minimal Bedrock bootstrap (`init-state --without-ovm`) with storage v2 is being investigated. einar-oplabs is attempting to reproduce the issue and has provided detailed logs of a successful `init-state` and node launch without a panic, suggesting the issue might be environment-specific or require specific steps to trigger.

### Investigate `debug_executePayload` and Related Crates Removal [#20879](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20879)
The issue, though closed, received a new comment from ajsutton clarifying that `debug_executePayload` is strictly required for `op-reth` to function as a source for `kona-proofs`. This reinforces the decision not to remove the functionality, as it serves as a critical performance optimization for fault-proof witness prefetching in both Go `op-program` and `kona`.

### op-supernode: Ignore Backfill Depth if Activation Timestamp is Not Set [#20892](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/20892)
This issue, which was closed today, addressed a problem where `op-supernode` failed to start if `backfill depth > 0` and the interop activation time was not set. A bounty was attempted by tiaraimpex410-sudo, and a PR was submitted to fix this behavior by ignoring backfill depth when the activation timestamp is not configured.
